sermon.title: Why Many USA Christians Have Lost the Will to Fight—September 13, 2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer declares that Jesus builds His church and hell can’t prevail. Many American Christians have lost the will to fight through doctrines that disarm them: believing Satan rules the nations, fearing politics, and misusing “resist not evil.” Like the apostles, we obey God rather than men and must share the river of life.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: What happened when the woman touched His hem?
faqs.answer: Virtue flowed out of Jesus and healed her of what men could not.

faqs.question: What are disarming doctrines?
faqs.answer: Doctrines that take the fight out of Christians; he covers six.

faqs.question: Can Satan destroy your life because he wants to?
faqs.answer: No. Just because he desires to doesn’t mean he can.
